tool.name: entra_get_tenant_info
tool.description:
Retrieve basic tenant information from Entra ID / Azure AD.
Use this as the first tool call in any identity audit to establish the tenant context — tenantId, display name, verified domains. The root agent calls this during pre-flight before spawning any sub-agents.

returns.description: Response containing: - success: bool - tenant_id: Azure AD tenant GUID - display_name: Tenant display name - tenant_type: e.g. "AAD" - created_date: ISO 8601 datetime - verified_domains: List of verified domain names

tool.name: entra_list_stale_users
tool.description:
List enabled user accounts that are stale — either never signed in or inactive beyond a configurable threshold.
Use this tool as the Stale Identity Agent to find dormant user accounts that represent unnecessary attack surface. Enabled accounts with no recent sign-in can be compromised without detection.
Returns accounts with stale_reason ("never_signed_in" or "inactive_Xd") and risk_level ("critical" for never signed in, "high" for >180d, "medium" for 90-180d).
Note: signInActivity requires AuditLog.Read.All permission.

parameter.name: stale_threshold_days
parameter.description: Number of days without sign-in to consider an account stale. Default: 90.

parameter.name: include_never_signed_in
parameter.description: Include accounts that have never signed in (created more than threshold days ago). Default: true.

returns.description: Response containing: - success: bool - total_users_scanned: Total enabled users checked - stale_count: Number of stale accounts found - threshold_days: Threshold used - stale_users: List of stale user objects, each with: object_id, display_name, upn, mail, user_type, account_enabled, created_datetime, last_sign_in_datetime, days_inactive, stale_reason, risk_level, on_premises_synced

tool.name: entra_list_stale_service_principals
tool.description:
List enabled service principals with no recent sign-in or usage activity.
Service principals (app identities) that are no longer used but remain enabled represent persistent access paths that may be forgotten and unmonitored. Uses the beta servicePrincipalSignInActivities endpoint.
Use this alongside entra_list_stale_users for complete stale identity coverage.

parameter.name: stale_threshold_days
parameter.description: Number of days without activity to consider a service principal stale. Default: 90.

returns.description: Response containing: - success: bool - total_sps_scanned: Total service principals checked - stale_count: Number of stale SPs found - threshold_days: Threshold used - stale_service_principals: List of stale SP objects, each with: object_id, app_id, display_name, sp_type, account_enabled, created_datetime, last_sign_in_datetime, days_inactive, stale_reason, risk_level

tool.name: entra_list_privileged_role_assignments
tool.description:
List all privileged role assignments in the tenant — both active direct assignments and PIM-eligible assignments.
Use this tool as the Privileged Role Agent to identify over-privileged users, service principals with administrative roles, guest users with elevated access, and excessive Global Administrator counts.
Automatically expands group memberships for group-based role assignments. Flags risk patterns: GA count > 3, guests in roles, service principals with GA.

parameter.name: include_eligible
parameter.description: Include PIM-eligible (not yet activated) assignments in addition to active assignments. Default: true.

returns.description: Response containing: - success: bool - total_privileged_assignments: Total assignments found - active_direct_count: Active direct assignments count - pim_eligible_count: PIM eligible assignments count - risk_flags: List of high-level risk observations - assignments: List of assignment objects, each with: assignment_id, role_definition_id, role_name, is_privileged, assignment_type (active_direct|pim_eligible), principal_id, principal_display_name, principal_type (user|group|servicePrincipal), principal_upn, principal_user_type, directory_scope_id, group_members

tool.name: entra_list_app_permissions
tool.description:
Audit OAuth application permissions, delegated grants, and app registration credential hygiene across the entire tenant.
Use this tool as the App Permission Agent to identify: - High-risk application permissions (Directory.ReadWrite.All, Mail.ReadWrite, etc.) - Admin-consented delegated grants with broad scope - Multi-tenant applications accepting sign-ins from any organization - Expired or long-lived client secrets/certificates - Apps from unverified publishers with sensitive permissions
Returns both application-type and delegated-type permission findings.

parameter.name: flag_high_risk_only
parameter.description: If true, only return findings matching the high-risk permission list. If false, returns all permissions. Default: false.

returns.description: Response containing: - success: bool - total_applications: App registrations scanned - total_service_principals: Service principals scanned - total_findings: Total findings across all categories - high_risk_count: Findings with critical or high severity - findings: List of finding objects. Each has: type (app_role_assignment|delegated_grant|expired_credential|long_lived_credential|multi_tenant_app), permission_category (application|delegated), app_id, display_name, permission_value, risk_level, is_high_risk, plus type-specific fields

tool.name: entra_list_guests
tool.description:
List all guest (B2B external) accounts in the tenant and assess their risk.
Use this tool as the Guest Access Agent to identify: - Guests holding privileged role assignments (Critical) - Guests from personal email domains like gmail.com, hotmail.com (High) - Stale guest accounts that remain enabled but are no longer active - Guests with broad group memberships
Cross-references guest accounts against role assignments automatically when check_role_assignments=true.

parameter.name: check_role_assignments
parameter.description: Cross-reference each guest against the tenant's role assignment list. Default: true.

parameter.name: check_group_memberships
parameter.description: Retrieve group memberships for each guest account. Default: true.

returns.description: Response containing: - success: bool - total_guests: Total guest accounts found - enabled_guests: Enabled guest count - guests_with_roles: Guests holding role assignments - guests_from_personal_domains: Guests from gmail.com, hotmail.com, etc. - guests: List of guest objects, each with: object_id, display_name, upn, mail, account_enabled, created_datetime, last_sign_in_datetime, days_inactive, original_domain, is_personal_domain, role_assignment_ids, group_memberships, risk_level, risk_reasons

tool.name: entra_list_conditional_access_policies
tool.description:
Retrieve all Conditional Access policies and named locations from the tenant.
Use this tool as the Conditional Access Gap Agent. Returns the full policy list including state (enabled|disabled|report-only), conditions, grant controls, and session controls.
Also performs quick gap detection: - No enabled policy enforcing MFA - Legacy authentication not blocked - All policies in report-only mode (non-enforcing)
The agent should build a coverage matrix from the raw policies to identify gaps for specific user/application combinations.

returns.description: Response containing: - success: bool - total_policies: Total policies in tenant - enabled_count: Actively enforced policies - report_only_count: Non-enforcing monitoring policies - disabled_count: Disabled policies - gap_signals: List of immediately detected gap patterns - policies: Full list of policy objects with conditions, grantControls, sessionControls - named_locations: All named location definitions

tool.name: entra_list_role_assignments_per_user
tool.description:
Return all role assignments pivoted to a per-user/per-principal dict.
Use this tool as the SoD (Segregation of Duties) Agent. Returns a dict keyed by principal_id mapping to the list of roles that principal holds.
Use the result to apply the SoD conflict matrix: - User Administrator + Authentication Administrator → full account takeover capability - Global Administrator + any role → redundant (GA includes all) - Application Administrator + Cloud Application Administrator → full app management - Privileged Role Administrator + Security Administrator → escalation + info access - Exchange Administrator + User Administrator → email exfiltration path - Any SP with Directory.ReadWrite.All + RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory → tenant takeover
Only report users where both conflicting assignments are confirmed active (not expired PIM eligibility schedules).

returns.description: Response containing: - success: bool - total_principals_with_roles: Total principals holding any role - multi_role_principals: Principals holding more than one role - assignments_per_user: Dict of { principal_id: [{ role_name, role_definition_id, assignment_type }] }
